title.zh-TW: 有快取的選用 MCP 改為呼叫時啟動
title.en: Cached optional MCP servers now start on first call

body.zh-TW:
工作流程中常會掛載多個 stdio 類型的選用 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器。

只要這些伺服器已經有工具清單的快取（把查過的資料暫存起來直接用），現在預設會等到第一次實際呼叫工具時才啟動。

⟦家裡的家電已經在牆上貼好說明書，以前一進門就把每台機器通電預熱，現在等到真的要按下按鈕時才啟動。⟧
body.en:
Workflows often attach multiple optional stdio MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers.

As long as those servers already have a cached tool list, they now wait until the first actual tool call to start by default.

⟦Home appliances already have manuals taped to the wall: instead of powering on and preheating every machine the moment you walk in, you wait until you actually need to press a button.⟧

items.original: Optional stdio MCP servers with cached tool lists now start on their first tool call by default. (#62366)

title.zh-TW: 個別應用程式工具可指定審核者
title.en: Set approval reviewers for individual app tools

body.zh-TW:
帳號裡接了多個外部服務，不同項目往往需要交給不同人把關。現在可以在 `config.toml` 裡，為個別已連結的應用程式工具單獨設定核准審核者。

⟦使用社區運動中心的不同器材時，以前全由同一位櫃台人員簽核，現在重訓室與泳池能各自指定專人把關放行。⟧
body.en:
When multiple external services are connected to your account, different items often need different people to review them. You can now set an approval reviewer in `config.toml` for each individual connected app tool.

⟦When using different equipment at a community sports center, a single front-desk attendant used to sign off on everything, whereas now the weight room and the pool can each have their own dedicated reviewer.⟧

items.original: Set an approval reviewer for individual connected app tools in `config.toml`. (#62360)

title.zh-TW: 可選用 Amazon Bedrock Runtime
title.en: Support for selecting Amazon Bedrock Runtime

body.zh-TW: 透過 app-server 運作的用戶端，在初始設定或登入帳號時都能直接選擇 Amazon Bedrock Runtime。
body.en: Clients running through app-server can select Amazon Bedrock Runtime directly during initial setup or sign-in.

items.original: App-server clients can select Amazon Bedrock Runtime during setup or sign-in. (#62222)

title.zh-TW: 接續與跨系統遠端工作階段保留路徑權限
title.en: Resumed and cross-OS remote sessions preserve paths and permissions

body.zh-TW:
重新接手先前的任務，或是跨作業系統連線執行遠端操作，最怕工作路徑與權限設定跑掉。

執行 `codex exec resume` 接續任務時，會自動還原先前儲存的沙盒（限制程式存取範圍的隔離環境）權限、工作目錄與工作區根目錄。只要沒有另外明確指定覆寫，這些設定都會照舊套用。

如果用戶端和伺服器跑在不同的作業系統上，遠端工作階段也會完整保留工作目錄、工作區根目錄與可寫入路徑。

⟦帶著畫箱到不同城市寫生時，以前每換一個地點就得重調顏料與筆刷位置，現在打開蓋子就能接回原本順手的擺法。⟧
body.en:
When picking up a previous task or connecting across operating systems for remote work, the last thing you want is for working paths and permission settings to drift.

When running `codex exec resume` to continue a task, previously saved sandbox (an isolated environment that restricts program access) permissions, the working directory, and workspace roots are automatically restored. Unless explicitly overridden, those settings apply as before.

If the client and server run on different operating systems, remote sessions also preserve working directories, workspace roots, and writable paths.

⟦Picture carrying a paintbox to sketch in different cities: you used to have to rearrange your paints and brushes at every stop, but now opening the lid brings back your familiar layout.⟧

items.original:
`codex exec resume` restores saved sandbox permissions, the working directory, and workspace roots unless explicitly overridden. (#62194)
Remote sessions preserve working directories, workspace roots, and writable paths when the client and server run on different operating systems. (#62375, #62376, #62377)

title.zh-TW: 即時回報錯誤並指出觸及的 API 花費上限
title.en: Report errors immediately and identify API spend limits reached

body.zh-TW:
等待模型逐字回應的過程中，一旦背後發生問題，早點看到明確提示才不用乾等。現在回應串流（模型邊生成邊傳回資料的過程）裡的服務商錯誤一傳回，Codex 就會立刻回報。若觸及 API 花費上限，也會指出達到的是哪一項上限。

⟦刷卡扣款失敗時，以前得等月底對帳單寄來才發現問題，現在交易當下立刻跳出提醒。若是額度滿了，也會寫明是哪一張卡。⟧
body.en:
While waiting for a model's word-by-word reply, seeing a clear error right away saves you from waiting in vain when something goes wrong. Codex now reports provider errors as soon as they arrive in a response stream (data sent back incrementally as the model generates it). If an API spend limit is reached, it also identifies which limit was hit.

⟦Think of a failed card charge: instead of waiting for the monthly statement to spot the problem, an alert pops up the moment the transaction happens, and if a limit is full, it tells you which card hit it.⟧

items.original: Codex reports provider errors as soon as they arrive in a response stream and identifies which API spend limit was reached. (#62329, #62356)

title.zh-TW: 打斷主回合時保留子代理的排隊回覆
title.en: Preserve queued child-agent replies when interrupting a parent turn

body.zh-TW:
主對話進行到一半被你按停時，底下分派出去的子代理可能還有幾則回覆正在排隊。現在中斷這個主對話回合後，子代理已經排進佇列的回覆不會消失，會直接留到下一個回合。

⟦樂團排練時指揮舉手喊停這一段，以前各聲部準備要接唱的樂句會直接作廢，現在會先留在譜架上等下一拍接續。⟧
body.en:
When you stop a main conversation mid-way, child agents dispatched underneath may still have replies waiting in line. Now, interrupting that parent turn keeps those queued child-agent replies instead of dropping them, carrying them over to the next turn.

⟦During an orchestra rehearsal, when the conductor raises a hand to stop a section, the phrases each voice part was ready to sing next used to be discarded, but now they stay on the music stand for the next beat.⟧

items.original: Interrupting a parent turn preserves queued replies from child agents for the next turn. (#62348)

title.zh-TW: 晚完成的雲端回覆會原地更新不亂序
title.en: Late cloud replies update in place to keep order

body.zh-TW:
打開舊對話並載入歷史紀錄後，先前送往雲端的任務可能剛好在這之後才跑完。現在這類晚一點完成的雲端回覆，會直接在原本的位置就地更新，讓終端機裡的對話紀錄維持正確順序。

⟦整理相簿時有幾張照片還在沖洗，以前晚拿到的只能硬貼到最後一頁，現在相簿會先留好原本那格等它補進來。⟧
body.en:
After you open an old conversation and load its history, tasks sent to the cloud earlier may finish right afterward. Those late-arriving cloud replies now update in place at their original position, keeping the terminal transcript in the right order.

⟦Imagine organizing a photo album while a few prints are still being developed: late arrivals used to get stuck onto the last page, whereas now the album reserves their original slots until they come in.⟧

items.original: Cloud replies that finish after history loads now update in place, keeping the terminal transcript in order. (#62403)

title.zh-TW: openai-docs 補齊 GPT-6.2 遷移指引
title.en: openai-docs adds GPT-6.2 migration guidance

body.zh-TW: 準備把現有串接切換到新模型之前，常得先確認呼叫格式與設定細節。Codex 內建的 `openai-docs` 技能現在已收錄遷移至 GPT-6.2 Astra 與 Sol 的說明，涵蓋端點（呼叫模型服務的連線位址）選擇與工具呼叫要求。
body.en: Before switching an existing integration to a new model, you often need to check request formats and configuration details first. Codex's bundled `openai-docs` skill now covers migrating to GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, including endpoint (the connection address for calling a model service) choices and tool-calling requirements.

items.original: The bundled `openai-docs` skill now covers migration to GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, including endpoint choices and tool-calling requirements. (#62447)

title.zh-TW: Code Mode 改統一走 gRPC 並棄用舊設定
title.en: Code Mode Standardizes on gRPC and Deprecates Old Setting

body.zh-TW:
在設定檔裡調整 Code Mode 連線方式的日子告一段落了。現在 Code Mode 的所有主機連線都一律改用 gRPC（一種常見的資料傳輸連線協定），原本的 `code_mode_host_grpc` 設定也隨之標記為棄用。

⟦老舊大樓原本還留著切換舊式電話線的撥鈕，現在所有分機全部改接同一種數位線路，牆上的切換開關也就跟著退役。⟧
body.en:
The days of adjusting how Code Mode connects in the configuration file are over. Code Mode now uses gRPC (a common data-transfer protocol) for all host connections, and the original `code_mode_host_grpc` setting is marked as deprecated.

⟦An old building once kept a toggle for legacy phone lines, and now that every extension has moved to a single digital line, the wall switch has been retired as well.⟧

entries: Added `-r` and `--resume` command-line flag aliases for `--conversation` so you can resume a specific conversation by ID with `agy -r <id>` or `agy --resume <id>`.

Added discovery of user-global skills in `~/.agents/skills`, so cross-tool Agent Skills appear in `/skills`, `/` autocomplete, and agent turns, with skills in `~/.gemini` taking precedence on name collisions.

Improved elapsed timers while the agent is working: the status line above the prompt now times thinking (`Thinking... 12s`) and each running tool (`Running command... 18s`) separately, resetting between phases and tools, and `Thought for <duration>` headers in the transcript now count only thinking time instead of including tool runs and response streaming.

Improved model quota tracking during turns lasting a minute or longer by refreshing your quota periodically while the agent streams, so `/usage`, `/quota`, and custom `statusLine` commands stay current before the turn finishes.

Improved the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode to keep the prompt bar anchored at the bottom of the terminal on new, short, or `Ctrl+L`-cleared conversations instead of starting near the top and sliding down as messages arrive.

Changed Auto mode (the default `Agent Mode`) to allow creating or editing files outside the workspace without asking when the file is inside a version-controlled repository (such as Git, Jujutsu, or Mercurial) or when the change only adds new content (creating a new file, appending, or inserting text without replacing existing lines); previously Auto mode asked before every outside-workspace file write or edit. Overwriting or replacing lines outside a repository, hidden paths, VCS and hook metadata such as `.git` and `hooks.json`, and system and startup folders still ask for approval, and your `ask` and `deny` permission rules and organization policies still apply.

Changed `pluginControls.pluginsDisabled` in managed admin settings and Gemini Enterprise plugin controls to keep built-in plugins enabled while still blocking installed, workspace, and marketplace plugins and plugin commands; previously it disabled built-in plugins as well.

Fixed failed and timed-out shell commands showing a green status dot instead of a red one in `low` and `high` verbosity, `/thinking`, and expanded (`Ctrl+O`) transcript views, while keeping canceled commands gray.

Fixed typing a custom write-in answer to an agent or subagent question hiding the terminal cursor at the bottom of the screen and misplacing IME composition text (such as Korean, Japanese, or Chinese); the hardware cursor now tracks your editing position.

Fixed running `agy` over SSH on macOS always bypassing your existing macOS Keychain sign-in and asking you to sign in again; when your login Keychain is unlocked, `agy` now reuses it and falls back to file-based token storage when locked.

Fixed `agy acp` stalling for 60 seconds when a subagent or workflow agent requested tool approval or asked a question in `default` or `accept-edits` mode; subagent permission requests, form prompts, and questions now forward to the editor and route your answers back to the subagent.

Fixed `/swarm` board wakeup notifications being attributed to whichever swarm member last opened the swarm instead of `"system"`, which could cancel member-scoped timers early and crowd out coordinator instructions when a worker's conversation compacted.

Fixed voice dictation in the Remote Control browser view recording an audio file attachment instead of transcribing speech into the message box (and hiding the microphone button in comment boxes), or failing to start microphone capture under the browser's content security policy.

Fixed voice dictation failing or timing out when starting in long conversations with large file reads or command outputs, and stalling when stopping a recording in the Remote Control browser view after out-of-order audio chunks.

Fixed opening, playing, or downloading audio and video files larger than 20 MB (up to 200 MB) in remote conversations in the Remote Control browser view failing with `File exceeds the 20MB display limit`.

Fixed navigating back from a conversation to the mobile home screen in the Remote Control browser view resetting the projects and conversations list to the top instead of restoring your scroll position.

title.zh-TW: 指令列支援 -r 與 --resume 接續對話

body.zh-TW: 昨天請 AI 改報告到一半關掉終端機，今天想靠對話 ID 接回同一段討論，不用再打完整的參數名稱。這版為 `--conversation` 加上兩個別名，直接輸入 `agy -r <id>` 或 `agy --resume <id>` 就能接續指定對話。
body.en: If you closed your terminal yesterday while asking AI to revise a report and want to pick up the same conversation by its ID today, you no longer need to type the full flag name. This release adds two aliases for `--conversation`, so you can run `agy -r <id>` or `agy --resume <id>` to resume a specific conversation.

title.zh-TW: 多步驟任務現在會顯示即時步驟清單
title.en: Multi-step tasks now show a live step checklist

body.zh-TW:
請代理人一口氣處理好幾個動作，盯著空白畫面常會不確定它做到哪裡。在多步驟的互動回合中，輸入框上方的狀態列底下現在會展開即時清單。

只要代理人透過 `update_steps` 追蹤進度，狀態列就會顯示 `N/M steps`，若有跳過或失敗的項目也會一併計數。清單最多展開 7 個步驟，項目更多時會用 `⋮ N earlier` 與 `⋮ N more` 標示前後還有幾項，等全部步驟都完成就會自動收起。⟦跟去大賣場拿著紙條採買一樣，以前得靠腦袋記住買到第幾樣，現在手邊攤開的清單隨買隨劃掉，東西拿齊了還會自己收進口袋。⟧
body.en:
When you ask the agent to handle several actions in one go, staring at a blank screen often leaves you guessing how far it has gotten. During multi-step interactive turns, a live checklist now opens under the status line above the prompt.

Whenever the agent tracks progress with `update_steps`, the status line displays `N/M steps`, along with counts for any skipped or failed items. The checklist shows up to 7 steps, using `⋮ N earlier` and `⋮ N more` when there are more items before or after, and hides automatically once all steps finish. ⟦Like shopping at a big-box store with a paper list, you no longer have to remember which item you are on—the open list lets you cross things off as you grab them and slips itself into your pocket once you have everything.⟧

items.original: Added a live step checklist under the status line above the prompt during multi-step interactive turns: when the agent tracks its steps with `update_steps`, the status line shows `N/M steps` (plus any skipped or failed count) and an open checklist of up to seven steps (`⋮ N earlier` and `⋮ N more` on longer lists) that hides automatically once all steps finish.

title.zh-TW: 支援 ~/.agents/skills 技能探索
title.en: Skill discovery now supports ~/.agents/skills

body.zh-TW:
平時換用不同 AI 工具整理資料，最麻煩的是同一套做法得在各家資料夾各複製一份。現在也支援探索放在 `~/.agents/skills` 的跨工具 Agent Skills（寫好流程給 AI 照做的擴充包）。

這些技能會直接出現在 `/skills` 清單與輸入 `/` 的自動補全裡，代理人執行回合時也能直接取用。如果剛好和 `~/.gemini` 裡的技能撞名，仍會優先採用 `~/.gemini` 的版本。⟦以前廚師每換一間廚房，都得把慣用的烹飪刀具重新擺一份；現在放到玄關的共用收納架，進哪間廚房都能順手拿來用，但屋主原本灶台上的那組還是優先。⟧
body.en:
When switching between different AI tools to organize information, the biggest hassle is keeping a separate copy of the same workflow in each tool's folder. Discovery now also supports cross-tool Agent Skills (extension packs with written workflows for AI to follow) placed in `~/.agents/skills`.

These skills appear directly in the `/skills` list and `/` autocomplete, and the agent can use them during its turns. If a name collides with a skill in `~/.gemini`, the `~/.gemini` version still takes precedence. ⟦Think of a chef who used to set up a fresh set of knives in every kitchen they entered; now the knives sit on a shared entryway rack ready for any kitchen, though the homeowner's own set on the counter still comes first.⟧

items.original: Added discovery of user-global skills in `~/.agents/skills`, so cross-tool Agent Skills appear in `/skills`, `/` autocomplete, and agent turns, with skills in `~/.gemini` taking precedence on name collisions.

title.zh-TW: 執行計時拆開計算並即時更新額度
title.en: Separate elapsed timers and live quota updates

body.zh-TW:
等代理人處理較長的任務，看著畫面上跳動的秒數或想確認剩餘額度，最怕數字還停在舊狀態。

現在輸入框上方的狀態列會把思考與跑工具分開計時，例如分別顯示 `Thinking... 12s` 和 `Running command... 18s`。每當切換階段或換下一個工具，計時就會歸零重算。對話紀錄裡的 `Thought for <duration>` 標題也只算思考時間，不再把跑工具與串流回覆的時間混進去。

遇到持續一分鐘以上的長回合，模型額度會在代理人串流回覆的過程中定期刷新。回合還沒結束前，輸入 `/usage`、`/quota` 或自訂的 `statusLine`（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）指令就能看到最新額度。⟦就像廚房為洗菜和燉湯分開按碼表，牆上的瓦斯餘量表也會邊煮邊更新，不必等整鍋端上桌才發現快見底。⟧
body.en:
While waiting on a longer task, watching the ticking seconds or checking your remaining quota is frustrating if the numbers are stuck on stale state.

The status line above the prompt now times thinking and tool runs separately, showing labels such as `Thinking... 12s` and `Running command... 18s`. Whenever the agent switches phases or moves to the next tool, the timer resets to zero. `Thought for <duration>` headers in the transcript also count only thinking time, without mixing in tool runs and response streaming.

For long turns lasting a minute or more, your model quota refreshes periodically while the agent streams its reply. Before the turn even finishes, running `/usage`, `/quota`, or custom `statusLine` (the bar displayed at the very bottom of the terminal) commands shows your latest quota. ⟦Picture a kitchen running separate stopwatches for washing vegetables and simmering soup, while the gas gauge on the wall updates as you cook so you don't wait until the pot hits the table to find out you're running low.⟧

items.original:
Improved elapsed timers while the agent is working: the status line above the prompt now times thinking (`Thinking... 12s`) and each running tool (`Running command... 18s`) separately, resetting between phases and tools, and `Thought for <duration>` headers in the transcript now count only thinking time instead of including tool runs and response streaming.
Improved model quota tracking during turns lasting a minute or longer by refreshing your quota periodically while the agent streams, so `/usage`, `/quota`, and custom `statusLine` commands stay current before the turn finishes.

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕模式把輸入列固定在終端機底部
title.en: Full-screen mode anchors the prompt bar at the bottom

body.zh-TW: 開啟 `full screen (altscreen)` 模式開新對話、瀏覽短對話，或剛按 `Ctrl+L` 清空畫面，輸入列以前會先出現在終端機上方。隨著訊息進來，輸入列才跟著往下滑。現在這幾種情況下，輸入列都會直接固定在終端機底部。
body.en: When you use `full screen (altscreen)` mode to start a new conversation, view a short one, or clear the screen with `Ctrl+L`, the prompt bar used to appear near the top of the terminal first. As messages arrived, it would then slide down. In all of these cases, the prompt bar now stays anchored at the bottom of the terminal.

items.original: Improved the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode to keep the prompt bar anchored at the bottom of the terminal on new, short, or `Ctrl+L`-cleared conversations instead of starting near the top and sliding down as messages arrive.

title.zh-TW: Auto 模式放寬工作區外安全寫檔限制
title.en: Auto mode relaxes safe file-write limits outside the workspace

body.zh-TW:
交給預設 `Agent Mode` 的 Auto 模式處理跨資料夾任務，以前只要寫入或改動工作區外檔案，每次都得先問過你。現在有兩種情況會直接放行。如果檔案位在 Git、Jujutsu 或 Mercurial 等版本控制存放庫（保留歷次修改紀錄的資料夾）內，就會直接處理。如果是只新增內容，例如建立新檔、在尾端附加或插入文字而不替換舊行，一樣不用先問。

不過在存放庫外覆寫或替換舊行，或碰到隱藏路徑、作業系統與開機資料夾，仍會先問。版本控制與 `hook`（特定事件發生時觸發的小程式）的設定資料如 `.git`、`hooks.json` 同樣要先核准，`ask` 與 `deny` 規則和組織政策也照舊生效。⟦在有複寫留底的帳本上補寫新收支，以前會計每次下筆都得先問過你；現在單純補記他能直接寫上去，但想塗改沒有留底的舊帳或翻動封條文件，照樣得先經你點頭。⟧
body.en:
When the Auto mode of the default `Agent Mode` handles tasks across folders, it used to ask for your approval before every write or edit outside the workspace. Two cases now proceed without asking. If the file lives inside a version-controlled repository (a folder that keeps a history of past changes) such as Git, Jujutsu, or Mercurial, it goes right ahead. If the change only adds new content—such as creating a new file, appending at the end, or inserting text without replacing existing lines—it skips the prompt as well.

However, overwriting or replacing existing lines outside a repository, or touching hidden paths, OS folders, or startup folders, still asks first. Configuration data for version control and `hook` (a small program triggered by specific events) setups like `.git` and `hooks.json` also require approval, and `ask` and `deny` rules plus organization policies remain in effect. ⟦An accountant adding new entries to a carbon-copy ledger used to ask you before every stroke; now plain additions go straight onto the page, while altering unbacked old entries or opening sealed documents still needs your nod.⟧

items.original: Changed Auto mode (the default `Agent Mode`) to allow creating or editing files outside the workspace without asking when the file is inside a version-controlled repository (such as Git, Jujutsu, or Mercurial) or when the change only adds new content (creating a new file, appending, or inserting text without replacing existing lines); previously Auto mode asked before every outside-workspace file write or edit. Overwriting or replacing lines outside a repository, hidden paths, VCS and hook metadata such as `.git` and `hooks.json`, and system and startup folders still ask for approval, and your `ask` and `deny` permission rules and organization policies still apply.

title.zh-TW: 停用外掛設定改為保留內建外掛運作
title.en: Disabling plugins now keeps built-in plugins active

body.zh-TW: 對採用管理員控管設定或 Gemini Enterprise 外掛控管的組織來說，過去開啟 `pluginControls.pluginsDisabled` 會把內建外掛一併關掉。這版調整後，這項設定會繼續封鎖已安裝、工作區與市集裡的外掛及外掛指令，但會保留內建外掛正常運作。⟦如果把門口的總電閘分成兩路，以前一拉下來連牆上的緊急指示燈也跟著全暗；現在只會切斷自己外接的延長線與插座，出廠內建的基礎照明照樣亮著。⟧
body.en: For organizations using managed admin settings or Gemini Enterprise plugin controls, enabling `pluginControls.pluginsDisabled` used to shut off built-in plugins as well. With this update, the setting still blocks installed, workspace, and marketplace plugins and plugin commands, while keeping built-in plugins running normally. ⟦Imagine splitting the main breaker at the door into two circuits: flipping it down used to black out even the emergency wall lights, whereas now it only cuts your own extension cords and outlets while the factory-built lighting stays on.⟧

items.original: Changed `pluginControls.pluginsDisabled` in managed admin settings and Gemini Enterprise plugin controls to keep built-in plugins enabled while still blocking installed, workspace, and marketplace plugins and plugin commands; previously it disabled built-in plugins as well.

title.zh-TW: 修正指令失敗與逾時狀態燈誤亮綠燈
title.en: Fixed green status dots on failed and timed-out commands

body.zh-TW: 打開 `low`、`high` 詳細度、`/thinking` 或按 `Ctrl+O` 展開的對話紀錄，以前常會被綠色圓點誤導，以為步驟都順利跑完。其實裡面可能有執行失敗或逾時的終端機指令，現在這兩種情況都會改亮紅燈，手動取消的指令則維持灰色。
body.en: When opening `low` or `high` verbosity, `/thinking`, or transcripts expanded with `Ctrl+O`, a green dot could mislead you into thinking every step succeeded. In reality, a shell command inside might have failed or timed out; both cases now show a red dot instead, while manually canceled commands stay gray.

items.original: Fixed failed and timed-out shell commands showing a green status dot instead of a red one in `low` and `high` verbosity, `/thinking`, and expanded (`Ctrl+O`) transcript views, while keeping canceled commands gray.

title.zh-TW: 修正自填回答時游標消失與輸入法錯位
title.en: Fixed missing cursor and IME drift on custom answers

body.zh-TW: 代理人或子代理發問而你選擇自行打字回答，過去終端機游標會躲到畫面最底下，中、日、韓文等輸入法的組字文字還會跑到別的位置。這個問題已經修好，現在硬體游標會跟著實際編輯位置移動。
body.en: When an agent or subagent asked a question and you chose to type a custom answer, the terminal cursor used to hide at the very bottom of the screen and IME composition text for Chinese, Japanese, or Korean would appear in the wrong spot. This is now fixed, so the hardware cursor follows your actual editing position.

items.original: Fixed typing a custom write-in answer to an agent or subagent question hiding the terminal cursor at the bottom of the screen and misplacing IME composition text (such as Korean, Japanese, or Chinese); the hardware cursor now tracks your editing position.

title.zh-TW: 修正 macOS 經 SSH 跑 agy 重複要求登入
title.en: Fixed repeated sign-in prompts for agy over SSH on macOS

body.zh-TW: 透過 SSH 遠端連進 macOS 執行 `agy`，過去會繞過你原本在 macOS Keychain（本機保管登入憑證的鑰匙圈）裡的登入狀態，每次都要求重新登入。這個問題已經修好，只要登入 Keychain 處於解鎖狀態，`agy` 現在會直接沿用；若處於鎖定狀態，就會改用檔案形式儲存 `token`（登入用的驗證令牌）作為備援。
body.en: Running `agy` over SSH on macOS used to bypass your existing sign-in state in macOS Keychain (the local store for sign-in credentials) and prompt you to sign in every time. This is now fixed: as long as your login Keychain is not locked, `agy` reuses it directly, and if it is locked, it falls back to storing your `token` (an authentication pass used for sign-in) in a file.

items.original: Fixed running `agy` over SSH on macOS always bypassing your existing macOS Keychain sign-in and asking you to sign in again; when your login Keychain is unlocked, `agy` now reuses it and falls back to file-based token storage when locked.

title.zh-TW: 修正 agy acp 轉送子代理請示卡住 60 秒
title.en: Fix agy acp stalling 60 seconds on subagent prompts

body.zh-TW: 在 `default` 或 `accept-edits` 模式下用 `agy acp` 連接編輯器，過去子代理或工作流程代理需要工具核准或向你發問，畫面會卡住 60 秒沒反應。現在已經修好，子代理的權限請求、表單提示與提問都會轉送到編輯器，你的回覆也會送回給子代理。
body.en: When using `agy acp` to connect to an editor in `default` or `accept-edits` mode, the screen previously stalled for 60 seconds without responding whenever a subagent or workflow agent needed tool approval or asked you a question. This is now fixed: subagent permission requests, form prompts, and questions forward to the editor, and your answers route back to the subagent.

items.original: Fixed `agy acp` stalling for 60 seconds when a subagent or workflow agent requested tool approval or asked a question in `default` or `accept-edits` mode; subagent permission requests, form prompts, and questions now forward to the editor and route your answers back to the subagent.

title.zh-TW: 修正 /swarm 喚醒通知歸屬錯誤
title.en: Fix /swarm wakeup notification attribution

body.zh-TW: 使用 `/swarm` 多代理協作，過去留言板的喚醒通知會被記在最後開啟這個群組的成員名下，而非 `"system"`。這樣一來，針對特定成員的計時器可能提前被取消，工作者的對話壓縮時也容易擠掉協調者的指示。現在通知來源已改回 `"system"`，不會再發生這兩種連鎖影響。
body.en: When collaborating with `/swarm`, board wakeup notifications were previously attributed to whichever member last opened the group instead of `"system"`. As a result, member-scoped timers could be canceled early, and coordinator instructions could be crowded out when a worker's conversation compacted. The notification source is now back to `"system"`, preventing both knock-on effects.

items.original: Fixed `/swarm` board wakeup notifications being attributed to whichever swarm member last opened the swarm instead of `"system"`, which could cancel member-scoped timers early and crowd out coordinator instructions when a worker's conversation compacted.

title.zh-TW: 修正語音聽寫無法轉文字與錄音卡住
title.en: Fix voice dictation transcription and recording stalls

body.zh-TW:
想在遠端控制網頁版或長對話裡直接開口輸入文字，過去語音聽寫有幾種情況會失靈。

在遠端控制網頁版，語音聽寫原本會直接錄成音訊附件，不會把說話內容轉寫進訊息框，留言框裡的麥克風按鈕還會不見。有時瀏覽器的內容安全政策（限制網頁能存取哪些功能的保護規則）也會擋住麥克風開始收音。現在這些情況已經修好，麥克風能正常收音並把語音轉成文字。

在讀過大檔案或長指令輸出的長對話裡啟動聽寫，以前容易失敗或逾時。在遠端控制網頁版若音訊片段沒有照順序送達，按下停止錄音也會卡住，現在這兩種情況都已解決。
body.en:
When trying to speak text directly in the Remote Control browser view or in long conversations, voice dictation previously failed in a few situations.

In the Remote Control browser view, voice dictation used to record an audio attachment instead of transcribing speech into the message box, and the microphone button in comment boxes would disappear. Sometimes the browser's content security policy (rules that restrict which features a page can access) also blocked the microphone from starting capture. These issues are now fixed, so the microphone captures audio properly and converts speech to text.

Starting dictation in long conversations with large file reads or long command outputs also used to fail or time out. In the Remote Control browser view, pressing stop on a recording could also stall if audio chunks arrived out of order; both cases are now resolved.

items.original:
Fixed voice dictation in the Remote Control browser view recording an audio file attachment instead of transcribing speech into the message box (and hiding the microphone button in comment boxes), or failing to start microphone capture under the browser's content security policy.
Fixed voice dictation failing or timing out when starting in long conversations with large file reads or command outputs, and stalling when stopping a recording in the Remote Control browser view after out-of-order audio chunks.

title.zh-TW: 修正遠端網頁版大型影音檔開啟失敗
title.en: Fix large media files failing to open in Remote Control

body.zh-TW: 在瀏覽器看遠端對話裡的錄音或影片，以前檔案稍微大一點就會直接被擋下來。只要超過 20 MB 就無法在遠端控制網頁版開啟、播放或下載，畫面還會跳出 `File exceeds the 20MB display limit`。現在已經修好，最高到 200 MB 的音訊與影片檔都能正常開啟、播放與下載。
body.en: When viewing audio or video in remote conversations from a browser, slightly larger files used to be blocked outright. Anything over 20 MB could not be opened, played, or downloaded in the Remote Control browser view, and `File exceeds the 20MB display limit` appeared on screen. This is now fixed, and audio and video files up to 200 MB can be opened, played, and downloaded normally.

items.original: Fixed opening, playing, or downloading audio and video files larger than 20 MB (up to 200 MB) in remote conversations in the Remote Control browser view failing with `File exceeds the 20MB display limit`.

title.zh-TW: 修正手機遠端網頁返回首頁列表跳回頂端
title.en: Fix mobile Remote Control resetting home list to top

body.zh-TW: 在行動裝置上滑了半天好不容易找到想看的項目，點進去看一眼再按上一頁，畫面卻又得重頭往下找起。過去在手機的遠端控制網頁版裡，從對話退回首頁時，專案與對話列表會直接重設回最頂端。現在已經修好，回到首頁會保留你原本的捲動位置。
body.en: On mobile, after scrolling to find an item, tapping into it, and going back, you had to search down from the top all over again. Previously, navigating back from a conversation to the home screen in the mobile Remote Control browser view reset the projects and conversations list to the very top. This is now fixed, and returning to the home screen preserves your scroll position.

items.original: Fixed navigating back from a conversation to the mobile home screen in the Remote Control browser view resetting the projects and conversations list to the top instead of restoring your scroll position.

title.zh-TW: 儀表板新增 /rename 幫工作階段改名
title.en: Dashboard adds /rename to rename sessions

body.zh-TW: 列表中同時留著好幾條舊紀錄，想替其中一條換個好認的標記，卻不想一一打開。現在選好目標後輸入 `/rename`，就能直接把那個工作階段改名，不用先打開它。⟦就像站在書架前替書換書腰，以前得先把整本書抽出來翻過才能改名，現在不用打開內頁就能直接寫上新名字。⟧
body.en: Several old records sit in the list, and you want to give one a clearer label without opening each one. Now you can select the target and enter `/rename` to rename that session directly without opening it first. ⟦Picture standing at a bookshelf to swap a book's belly band: before, you had to pull the whole book out and flip through it to change the name, whereas now you can write the new name right away without opening the pages.⟧

items.original: New `/rename` command on the dashboard renames the selected session without opening it

title.zh-TW: 新增 /models 指令從伺服器重抓模型清單
title.en: New /models command refreshes the model list from the server

body.zh-TW: 不確定畫面上顯示的模型還是不是最新一批，卻不想靠猜的。輸入 `/models`，就會直接向伺服器重新抓取目前可用的模型清單。⟦跟走到自動販賣機前按下更新鍵一樣，不用憑印象猜測，直接向倉庫抓回最新上架的品項清單。⟧
body.en: You are not sure whether the models shown on screen are still the latest batch, and you do not want to guess. Entering `/models` fetches the currently available model list directly from the server again. ⟦Think of walking up to a vending machine and pressing a refresh button: instead of guessing from memory, you pull the latest stocked item list straight from the warehouse.⟧

items.original: New `/models` command refreshes the available model list from the server

title.zh-TW: /hooks 清單改用清楚欄位顯示檔名與設定
title.en: /hooks list now shows file names and settings in clear fields

body.zh-TW: 查看自動化設定不用再對著原始指令硬猜用途。`/hooks` 清單每一列現在都會顯示 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）的檔案名稱。各項設定也改成在易讀的欄位裡列出，不再直接傾倒原始指令。⟦配電箱打開來，以前裡面只塞著一長串難懂的原始線路代號，現在每個開關旁都印好檔名跟設定項目。⟧
body.en: Checking your automation setup no longer means guessing what raw commands do. Each row in the `/hooks` list now displays the file name of the hook (a small program triggered by a specific event). Settings are also listed in readable fields instead of dumping raw commands. ⟦Open a breaker box: before, it was stuffed with a long string of cryptic raw wiring codes, and now each switch has its file name and settings printed right beside it.⟧

items.original: `/hooks` rows now show the hook file name and list settings in readable fields instead of dumping raw commands

title.zh-TW: MCP 伺服器檢視與開關設定更準確
title.en: More accurate MCP server inspection and toggle behavior

body.zh-TW:
調整或檢查 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，現在能看到更清楚的狀態與路徑。

在 `/mcps` 裡，除非裡頭超過十台伺服器，否則代管區塊預設會直接展開。

在已經執行的終端機介面工作階段裡，`grok mcp disable` 與 `grok mcp enable` 現在能正確停止對應的伺服器。

執行 `grok inspect` 檢查專案自訂的 MCP 伺服器時，回報的設定檔位置現在能正確對應到 `.grok/config.toml` 或 `.mcp.json`。

這樣一來，清單展開範圍、進行中工作階段的伺服器停用，以及設定檔路徑都跟實際狀態一致。
body.en:
When adjusting or checking MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers, you now see clearer statuses and paths.

In `/mcps`, hosted sections are now expanded by default unless they contain more than ten servers.

Inside already-running terminal UI sessions, `grok mcp disable` and `grok mcp enable` now properly stop the corresponding servers.

When running `grok inspect` on project-defined MCP servers, the reported config file location now accurately points to `.grok/config.toml` or `.mcp.json`.

As a result, list expansion scope, stopping servers in active sessions, and config file paths all match the actual state.

items.original:
`/mcps` now shows hosted sections expanded by default unless they contain more than ten servers
`grok mcp disable` (and enable) now correctly stops servers inside already-running TUI sessions
`grok inspect` now reports the correct project `.grok/config.toml` or `.mcp.json` file for project-defined MCP servers

title.zh-TW: /workflows 清單按 Enter 可直接開檔並搜尋
title.en: Pressing Enter in /workflows opens the file for viewing and searching

body.zh-TW: 平時對照工作流程定義，總得確認裡面的步驟寫法。現在游標停在 `/workflows` 清單的項目上按下 `Enter`，就會直接開啟該流程的檔案，方便你瀏覽與搜尋內容。
body.en: When reviewing workflow definitions, you often need to check how the steps are written. Now, pressing `Enter` on an item in the `/workflows` list opens that workflow's file directly so you can browse and search its contents.

items.original: Enter on a workflow in the `/workflows` list now opens its file for viewing and searching

title.zh-TW: 全展開模式重複收合思考時會提示關閉快捷鍵
title.en: Hint shows the toggle shortcut when repeatedly collapsing thoughts in expand-all mode

body.zh-TW: 每次回答一長串思考過程，你可能忍不住一塊一塊手動把它們摺起來，卻忘了全部展開模式還開著。在全部展開開啟的狀態下，只要你持續把思考段落一個個收起來，畫面就會跳出提示，列出用來關掉全部展開的組合鍵。⟦你一盞一盞手動關掉小燈，旁邊的人看你連按好幾顆，就會順手指給你看總開關的位置在哪。⟧
body.en: When a response includes a long chain of thought steps, you might find yourself folding them up one by one without realizing expand-all mode is still on. While expand-all is enabled, if you keep collapsing thought sections individually, a hint appears showing the key chord that turns expand-all off. ⟦As you switch off small lights one by one, someone watching you press several switches in a row points out where the master switch is.⟧

items.original: A new contextual hint appears when you keep collapsing thoughts while expand-all is on, showing the chord that turns it off

title.zh-TW: 問答卡打字與貼上回答不再誤觸快捷鍵或捲過頭
title.en: Typing and pasting on question cards no longer trigger shortcuts or overscroll

body.zh-TW:
在問答卡上想填寫自己的回答，以前操作常出狀況。現在打字或貼上回答內容，都不會再被誤認成快捷鍵。

打字輸入回答的過程中，問答卡清單也不會再捲超過最後一個選項。
body.en:
Entering your own answer on a question card used to run into input issues. Now, typing or pasting an answer is no longer misinterpreted as a shortcut.

While typing an answer, the question card list also no longer scrolls past the last option.

items.original:
Typed or pasted answers on question cards are no longer misinterpreted as shortcuts
Question card lists no longer scroll past the last option while typing an answer

title.zh-TW: 儀表板派送與快速檢視回覆框操作改進
title.en: Improved controls in dashboard dispatch and peek reply boxes

body.zh-TW:
打字打一半想一口氣清掉剛敲錯的字詞，不用再連按倒退鍵。現在在儀表板的派送與快速檢視回覆框裡按 `Ctrl+W`，就能刪掉前一個單字。

當派送訊息正在等待圖片傳送時，快速檢視回覆框依然可以正常接收按鍵輸入與貼上內容。
body.en:
When you want to clear a mistyped word mid-sentence, you no longer need to tap backspace repeatedly. Pressing `Ctrl+W` in the dashboard dispatch and peek reply boxes now deletes the previous word.

While a dispatch message is waiting on an image transfer, the peek reply box still accepts keystrokes and pasted content normally.

items.original:
Ctrl+W now deletes the previous word in the dashboard dispatch and peek reply boxes
Dashboard peek still accepts keys and pastes while a dispatch send waits on an image

title.zh-TW: 接續工作階段後背景任務與工作流程位置修正
title.en: Fixed placement of background tasks and workflows after resuming a session

body.zh-TW: 事情做到一半暫停，回頭重開紀錄繼續進行，裡頭有些項目常會插錯順序。這個問題已經修好，現在重開工作階段後，背景任務與工作流程都會出現在對話紀錄裡正確的順序位置。
body.en: When you paused halfway through a task and reopened the record to continue, some items would end up out of order. That issue is fixed: after resuming a session, background tasks and workflows now appear in the right order in the transcript.

items.original: Background tasks and workflows now appear in the correct place in the transcript after resuming a session

title.zh-TW: 搜尋與篩選列的選取錯位與語法錯誤提示修正
title.en: Fixed selection offset and syntax error message in search and filter bars

body.zh-TW:
在區塊檢視器裡用搜尋列找內容，以前容易點選到被搜尋列蓋住的那一行。現在搜尋列不會再誤選被它擋在底下的那行文字。

當輸入的 regex（正規表達式，用符號匹配字串的語法）格式無效時，搜尋列與篩選列現在會直接顯示 `bad pattern`。
body.en:
When searching in the block viewer, it used to be easy to select the line covered by the search bar. The search bar no longer mistakenly selects the line of text hidden underneath it.

When an invalid regex (regular expression, a syntax for matching strings with symbols) is entered, the search and filter bars now directly display `bad pattern`.

items.original:
Block viewer search bar no longer selects the line hidden under it
Search and filter bars now show `bad pattern` when the regex is invalid

title.zh-TW: 回覆中的無效連結改顯示為純文字
title.en: Dead links in replies now appear as plain text

body.zh-TW: 回覆裡有時會夾帶已經失效的連結，過去畫面還是把它畫成可點擊的超連結。現在回覆中的無效連結只會以純文字呈現，不會再顯示為可點擊的連結。
body.en: Replies sometimes include dead links, which the screen used to render as clickable hyperlinks. Now dead links in replies appear only as plain text rather than clickable links.

items.original: Dead links in replies now appear as plain text rather than clickable links

title.zh-TW: /goal pause 後的階段計時器改從零起算
title.en: Phase timers after /goal pause now start from zero

body.zh-TW: 使用 `/goal pause` 之後查看階段計時，過去畫面上會留著過時的舊時間。現在 `/goal pause` 後的階段計時器會從零開始計時，不再顯示殘留的舊時間。
body.en: When checking phase timing after using `/goal pause`, the screen used to keep showing stale time. Now phase timers after `/goal pause` start from zero and no longer display leftover old time.

items.original: Phase timers after `/goal pause` now start from zero instead of showing stale time

title.zh-TW: grok update 輸出不再夾帶內部代號與設定檔
title.en: grok update output no longer includes internal IDs or config files

body.zh-TW: 更新完工具想確認畫面訊息，以前總會混進幾行給研發端看的編號和檔名。現在 `grok update` 的輸出已經移除這些內部項目，不再顯示實驗 ID 或設定檔名稱。
body.en: When checking screen messages after updating the tool, a few lines of IDs and filenames meant for developers used to get mixed in. Now `grok update` has removed these internal items from its output and no longer displays experiment IDs or config file names.

items.original: `grok update` no longer mentions internal experiment IDs or config files in its output

title.zh-TW: 登入畫面貼上金鑰時不再點名環境變數
title.en: Sign-in screen no longer names an environment variable when pasting a key

body.zh-TW: 把存好的通行憑證複製進帳號驗證框，以前頁面還會順帶寫出一個系統參數的名字。現在當你可能貼上了已儲存的金鑰，登入畫面不再顯示環境變數名稱。
body.en: When copying a saved credential into the account verification box, the page used to also mention the name of a system parameter. Now when you may have pasted a saved key, the sign-in screen no longer displays an environment variable name.

items.original: Sign-in screen no longer names an environment variable when a saved key may have been pasted

title.zh-TW: 服務端連上卻不回傳時對話與壓縮不再卡死
title.en: Turns and compaction no longer hang when a provider connects without responding

body.zh-TW: 進行對話輪次或壓縮對話內容，萬一供應商雖然建立連線卻始終沒送回回應，以前畫面會就此卡住。這個問題已經修好，現在碰到供應商連上卻無回應時，輪次與對話壓縮都不會再卡死。
body.en: During conversation turns or content compaction, if a provider established a connection but never sent back a response, the screen used to freeze. This issue is now fixed, so when a provider connects without responding, neither turns nor conversation compaction will hang anymore.

items.original: Turns and compaction no longer hang when a provider connects but never sends a response

first_title.zh-TW: MCP 伺服器支援動態產生請求標頭
first_title.en: MCP servers support dynamic request headers

entries: On a compacted `session/read` or `session/resume`, a `prunedSubagents` entry now carries the subagent's own `subagentId` and, for a nested subagent, its parent's `parentSubagentId` when they are known, so a client can show a pruned nested subagent under its parent

`session/fork` takes the new session's `modelId` and `config` like `session/start` and `session/resume`, reports a refused model in `modelIdRefusal` and unapplied settings in `warnings` (experimental members)
When your account includes 3D generation, ask for a 3D model and Muse Code makes a GLB, FBX or USDZ file from an image
With the shell sandbox off, the session-start permission note now says a command can change any file this user can write, anywhere on this host, instead of claiming it can change any file on the host

Turning a skill on or off now saves it in settings under the skill's name (`bundled:<id>` for a built-in skill, `plugin:<plugin>:<skill>` for a plugin skill) and removes that skill's older entries, so the setting keeps working when a skill's files move; an older version ignores switches saved this way
An installed plugin that declares `replaces` on a skill entry now gets a warning naming the plugin and the field, and the field is ignored
The `session/goalChanged` notification now carries the goal's created and updated times after the agent's goal tools change it
`/resume` says how many sessions open in another Muse process it left out, and no longer reports "No saved sessions found" when those are the only ones
Built-in skills show as `bundled://skills/<name>/SKILL.md` instead of naming an internal package; old `bundled://muse-core/...` paths and settings keys keep working

The Python environment skill and the guidance that keeps a requested short answer short are now built-in plugins of their own, `python-env` and `guidance-match-requested-length`, so `plugins.activation` can turn each off by itself; settings that turn `muse-core` off still turn them off, and a plugin you install can no longer take either id
Read saved output of a background command even when its full command is also saved

On Linux, when a sandboxed shell command cannot start because an empty file such as `~/.config` sits where a directory is needed, the error now names that file and says to remove it and run the command again once no sandboxed command is running
Preserve quoted reference lines in background command text

When a long message with a video attached is shortened at compaction, its full text is now saved like any other long message, and the line naming the file says the video was not saved, as it already did for images
Task rows no longer show a stray output: or status: word when a command printed only a blank line

When the settings file cannot be read, plugins are switched off for that run unless a project settings file turns them on by name, so plugins you turned off cannot come back on with their hooks and connected servers
When moving MCP servers over from Claude Code or Codex, the agent now keeps `${VAR}` references in `env`, `url`, and header values instead of leaving the server out or asking you to paste the secret
When a shell command cannot start, for example because `zsh` is not installed, the error now names the program and folder that failed instead of only "No such file or directory"
The bundled Three.js and 3D visuals skills no longer recommend a shadow-map type that current three.js has deprecated, so scenes built from them keep soft shadows without a console warning
Inherited test settings no longer simulate a full disk or pause session history writes in release builds
On Windows, a clean `--worktree create` session worktree is now removed when the session ends instead of being kept after a "Permission denied" cleanup failure
On Linux or macOS, `--no-session-log` in the terminal or `exec` no longer creates empty `session-server` and `runtime` folders in your data folder
When a background command finishes after the turn ends and the agent's reply to its result is empty, the agent now writes a short final summary instead of ending with no answer
When the agent plans a design doc with the plan skill, it asks one open question per turn instead of up to three at once

When the agent queues a message for a subagent, the tool result now says the message was queued for the subagent instead of naming an internal tracking number the agent could mistake for the message's id
When `web_fetch` saves a binary file such as a PDF, its result no longer mentions a prompt the tool does not take
`muse exec` now also says at startup when your own user or project skill has the same name as a built-in skill, and shows the `bundled:<name>` id that still opens the built-in

When a goal is set, a subagent woken by its own background work no longer saves a broken checkpoint as it compacts, which could stop the session from reading the subagent and end an `exec` run with an error
Sessions now ride out a brief model outage inside the turn with a visible countdown instead of ending the turn

After a session is compacted a second time, the `prunedSubagents` list on `session/read` and `session/resume` shows a subagent that finished between the two compactions as finished instead of running, keeps a finished subagent whose spawn was recorded across the cut, and lists the parent of a pruned nested subagent so the nested subagent shows under it
Sessions served by `muse serve` now pick the approval reviewer's model as the TUI does, from the session's model and the model catalog, instead of always reviewing on the host's default model
On Windows, a too-large project or user `SKILL.md` warning now says how far over the limit the file really is, instead of always one byte over
A corrected call shows the success mark when its retry succeeded, and keeps the failure mark when the retried command itself failed

When you stop a shell command (Esc, or it hits its time limit) and its processes cannot be confirmed to have ended, the command still shows as cancelled or timed out, and now also shows `cleanup not confirmed: <reason>`, so you and the model know something it started may still be running
A resumed session whose compaction completed no longer shows a false "runtime closed before context compaction completed" error row beside it
`session/list`, `session/read` and `session/resume` count every turn of a session in `turnCount`, including a turn that failed, one that was interrupted and withdrawn, and one still running
`muse resume` explains when a session stopped during startup and no conversation was lost, instead of only reporting that no log was saved
A rewind no longer waits forever when the session it starts from is too busy to take it; it now fails after the request timeout
In `/subagents` and the subagent detail view, a subagent you stopped now reads `stopped` instead of `cancelled`, matching its work status
Older sessions no longer advertise command text as full tool output in the session protocol

With a Meta model and a model list to read, `muse serve` reports context usage against the window of the model it starts with, including a model the list does not show, instead of the default model's window or none
In `/subagents`, a nested subagent you stopped now reads `stopped` instead of `cancelled`, matching its work status
Reopening a session no longer says context compaction failed to complete when it finished
A `tbh serve` host started with `--no-session-log`, including `--listen`, no longer writes its exit record (`serve-exit.jsonl`) into your data folder; it still prints why it exited on stderr

On Windows, quitting tbh or finishing `tbh exec` now also ends the programs a background PowerShell session started (run without the sandbox), as it already did on macOS and Linux, instead of leaving them running

`muse plugins reject` on a plugin compiled into the binary (such as `foreign-script-guard`) with nothing to revoke now refuses (JSON error code `builtin-plugin-not-revocable`) and names the product gate and the environment variable that switch it off, instead of printing a count-0 rejection that changed nothing; bundled plugins such as `muse-core` keep the count-0 success

When a background command finishes and saving its completion notice to the session fails once, the notice now reaches the model on the next report; before, the model was never told the command had ended
Resuming a session whose earlier process ended while its MCP servers were starting now starts them again, instead of leaving MCP disabled and refusing turns when a server is required

After a subagent with follow-ups compacts its own history and the session is reopened, reading that subagent's result now returns its latest answer instead of saying the result is out of date; sessions saved by earlier versions still say it is out of date
Keep quoted error details out of resumed background command previews
`muse serve` sessions whose `run.toolset` names a goal or cron tool the session provides, such as `report_progress` or `cron_list`, now start instead of failing with an unknown tool names error

Long sessions with dense content, such as code or CJK text, now compact before they overflow the model's context window. The session no longer discards the provider's reported prompt size when the request offered no hosted web search

title.zh-TW: Muse Code 能從圖片生出 3D 模型檔
title.en: Muse Code can generate 3D model files from images
